educationalGoal: Through experiments and exercises, students will acquire the basic concepts and techniques in conducting biological and chemical experiments using buffer preparation, pH measurement, neutralization titration, and biochemical experiments and exercises with microorganisms
advice:
After attending safety training for chemical experiments and microbial experiments, we will start experiments divided into the following three themes:

1. Chemical analysis experiments.
2. Microbial separation experiments.
3. Microbial metabolism experiments.

Experiment guidebooks will be distributed for each theme. Students are required to prepare for and complete each experiment.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              After attending safety training for chemical experiments and microbial experiments, we will start experiments divided into the following three themes:

1. Chemical analysis experiments.
2. Microbial separation experiments.
3. Microbial metabolism experiments.

Experiment guidebooks will be distributed for each theme. Students are required to prepare for and complete each experiment.
